entities.name: Will Kenrith
entities.description: A former planeswalker specializing in ice magic, twin of Rowan and the acting king of Eldraine; he lost his spark in the Desparkening.

entities.name: Rowan Kenrith
entities.description: Will's twin sister, with whom he shared a single spark.

entities.name: Algenus Kenrith
entities.description: The twins' father and High King of Eldraine, abducted by Oko and Garruk, killed and restored, and later killed by Phyrexian invaders.

entities.name: Linden
entities.description: The twins' stepmother who restored Algenus using his Questing Sword.

entities.name: Oko
entities.description: A planeswalker who abducted the High King with Garruk.

entities.name: Garruk Wildspeaker
entities.description: A planeswalker hunter cursed by the Chain Veil who is cured when Will rescues him.

entities.name: Cerise
entities.description: A childhood friend of Will.

entities.name: Titus
entities.description: A childhood friend of Will.

entities.name: Indrelon
entities.description: The Magic Mirror that reveals the location of the High King.

entities.name: Kasmina
entities.description: Invited the siblings to join Strixhaven.

entities.name: Professor Onyx
entities.description: A Strixhaven professor who tasked the twins with defending against the Oriq; in truth Liliana Vess.

entities.name: Extus Narr
entities.description: Oriq leader bound to a Snarl who is killed by the Blood Avatar.

entities.name: Blood Avatar
entities.description: A summoned entity that killed Extus Narr and severed Will's leg.

entities.name: Imodane
entities.description: A raiding knight who pledged fealty to Will.

entities.name: Ashiok
entities.description: A planeswalker defeated at Castle Ardenvale.

entities.name: Kellan
entities.description: A hero who helped defeat Ashiok.

entities.name: Ruby
entities.description: A hero who helped defeat Ashiok.

entities.name: Eriette
entities.description: A witch, Will's aunt, captured to end the Wicked Slumber.

entities.name: Eldraine
entities.description: The plane Will rules as acting king.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane of Strixhaven.

entities.name: Kylem
entities.description: Plane where the twins were champions at Valor's Reach.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university on Arcavios attacked by the Oriq.

entities.name: Castle Ardenvale
entities.description: Where the twins' parents were killed and later assaulted by Will.

entities.name: Castle Vantress
entities.description: Castle where Will took residence.

entities.name: Oriq
entities.description: Faction that attacked Strixhaven.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which the twins' parents were killed.

entities.name: Desparkening
entities.description: Event in which Will and Rowan lost their shared spark.

entities.name: Wicked Slumber
entities.description: A curse ended when Eriette was captured.

entities.name: Wild Hunt
entities.description: Hunters who killed the transformed High King.

events.summary: Will and Rowan are born to a witch who kills the newborns for their blood; their adoptive mother restores them and raises them.
events.quote: Their birth mother killed the newborns for their blood, which she would have drunk to extend her life.

events.summary: Will has a vision in the ice at seventeen.
events.quote: At seventeen, Will experienced a vision in a sheet of ice.

events.summary: The twins quest for their abducted father; Will rescues Garruk, summoning the Cauldron of Eternity which cures him.
events.quote: Later on, Will rescues Garruk from certain death.

events.summary: The twins fail to protect the stag from the Wild Hunt; Linden restores the High King.
events.quote: bringing Algenus back to life by using his Questing Sword.

events.summary: The shock of learning their origins ignites the twins' spark and they disappear.
events.quote: The shock ignites the twins' planeswalker's spark and they disappear.

events.summary: The twins compete as champions of Valor's Reach on Kylem.
events.quote: The twins were champions of Valor's Reach .

events.summary: Kasmina invites the twins to Strixhaven; Professor Onyx tasks them with defending against an Oriq attack.
events.quote: The siblings were invited to join Strixhaven as students by Kasmina .

events.summary: Will and Rowan face Extus Narr and the Blood Avatar beneath the Biblioplex; Will gains control of the Avatar, which kills Extus Narr but severs Will's leg.
events.quote: The Avatar killed the Oriq leader and was sent back from where it came, but not before it hacked off Will's leg.

events.summary: Will and Rowan's parents are killed by Phyrexian invaders defending Castle Ardenvale.
events.quote: Will and Rowan's parents were killed by the invaders while defending Castle Ardenvale .

events.summary: The twins lose their shared spark; Will takes his father's crown, declaring himself High King.
events.quote: Will took up his father's crown, declaring himself High King of the Realm

events.summary: Will wins Imodane's fealty, assaults Castle Ardenvale, defeats Ashiok with Kellan and Ruby, and captures Eriette, ending the Wicked Slumber; Rowan escapes into the Wilds.
events.quote: capture the witch Eriette , ending the Wicked Slumber.

relations.quote: He is the twin brother of Rowan Kenrith .
his father was High King Algenus Kenrith
Will was able to convince the raiding knight Imodane to pledge fealty to him.
The Avatar killed the Oriq leader
Later on, Will rescues Garruk from certain death.
